tools.name: tempika_check_api_key
tools.description: Check the Tempika API key. Returns its tenant id, its scopes and its requests-per-minute limit. Call this first to see which tools the key can use. Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/health.

tools.name: tempika_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees of the tenant, without personal data: id, status, company id and external reference. Needs scope employees:read. Pass nextCursor as cursor to get the next page. Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/employees.

tools.name: tempika_list_time_entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out entries for a period, without sensitive data: employee id, type, time and source. Needs scope time-entries:read. If truncated is true, use a shorter from/to range, or add companyId or employeeId. Tempika API: GET /api/public/v1/time-entries.

tools.name: tempika_get_workday_report
tools.description: Get the aggregated working-time report for a period: entry count, distinct employees, overtime, absence requests and net hours bank. Totals only, no rows and no personal data.
